tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ro snyoms sgang 'dril bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// na mo rat+na gu ru/ dpal bde chen stengs su gsungs pa/ bu chos la lag len cig dgos pa yin/ gzhi ma dam tshig dang sdom pa ma nyams pa'i steng nas/ rtogs ldan gyi bla ma gcig la/ gsol ba btab cing sems ma bcos par bskyangs nas/ snang ba gang shar gyi steng du 'jog pa 'di/ bsgom ma skyes pa bskyed byed kyang yin/ skye nas bogs 'don kyang 'di las zab pa med/ chos rje ras pa'i khyad chos ro snyoms skor drug kyang phyag rgya chen po skyong ba'i gdams ngag yin te/ lag len 'di las med/ ro snyoms 'di mdo sngags thams cad kyi nying khu yin gsung*/ de la dang po rnam rtog lam du 'khyer ba ltas ngan g.yang du 'don pa'i gdam ngag la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad rnam par rtog pa las byung ste/ rnam snang mngon byas las/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung byed yin// ces gsungs/ rtog pa de rang dgar ma shor gnyen pos ma spangs par gdams ngag gis lam du byas tsa na/ mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ nam mkha' bzhin du rtog med gsal// ces pa de yod pa yin te/ rtog pa de ma spangs par gnas su dag nas/ nyams len chos skur krongs te yong gsungs/ des na nyon mongs pa rnam rtog 'di rnams lung ma bstan yin/ thabs kyis zin na lam du 'gro/ rang dgar spyad na 'khor ba'i rgyu mi dge ba bskyed de/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// ces gsungs/ mi dge ba yang thabs kyis zin na lam du 'gro srid gsung*/ rnam rtog lam khyer gyi gdam ngag gam/ thabs de gang yin gyis dang*/ ro snyoms nas dang po rnam rtog ngos bzung bar du bdag 'dzin blos btang*/ tha ma re dogs kyi 'phrang bsal ba bya ba yod pas/ rnam rtog ngos bzung na slob dpon gyis da nga la chos gcig gsungs na dga' ste/ khrid gcig btab na dga' ste snyam pa de yin/ bsgom na/

ma nam mkha' ma nus tshad bgrangs zhing*/ sems ji ltar 'dug pa ltar ma bcos par bzhag na/ rdza lung dgu pa yang tshos te/ gdam ngag thob thob po gcig 'dod pa 'di/ tshe 'di'i rnam rtog yin mod 'o na/ rtog pa de ngos tsir gyis bzung nas rjes su yang mi 'breng*/ spongs yang mi spong par/ sems bcas bcos med par gang shar de'i steng du lhod de bzhag pas rtog pa de nyid la nyams len gyi ngo ti byas nas/ ji ltar 'dug pa de ka ltar gsal ye re lhod de shigs se bzhag pas/ der rtog pa de nyid spong ma dgos/ gnyen po ye shes gcig logs nas brtsal mi dgos par/ gang shar de yang sngang dang bral nas nyams len du lhangs kyis 'char ba de la ci zer byas na rnam rtog phra rags thams cad nyams len du 'char ba zhes bya/ rnam rtog chos skur shar bas rnam rtog lam khyer mngon du gyur pa bya ba yin/ 'di ka la rje gling ras pas/ ma bcos so mar bzhag na rtogs pa 'char// chu bo'i rgyun du bsgoms nas yongs kyang 'char// dmigs gtad mtshan ma thams cad yongs spong la// rtag tu mnyam par zhog gcig rnal 'byor pa// gsungs nam mkha' rin po che'i mdo nas kyang*/ ji ltar mar la mar bzhag gam// ci ltar chu la chu bzhag ltar// rang gi rig pa'i ye shes ni// legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin// 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// ces bshad/ rje bram ze chen pos kyang*/ gnyug ma'i yid ni gcig tu gdod dang rnal 'byor pa// chu la chu bzhag bzhin du shes par byos// ces gsungs pas nyams len de rtog pa gcig gi steng du shes tsam na/ 'dam bu gcig khong stong na thams cad khog stong bya ba yin pas/ rtog pa thams cad 'dis lam du 'khyer ba yin/ bsgom mtho ru song nas rtog pa phra mo thams cad chos skur 'char ba'i dus su yang nyams len bzang na de ma brtag gis dogs pa'i rtog pa 'ong*/

ngan dus su des ma chog gis dogs pa'i rtog pa 'ong*/ gnyid mthug por song ba dang*/ g.yeng ba la 'byams tsa na rang sa na 'dzin pa med kyang*/ ngos ma zin pa 'di rnams lam du 'gro 'am mi 'gro snyam pa'i rtog pa 'ong*/ dran pa rgyun chags su skyes dus su 'di lam du 'gro yis snyam pa 'ong*/ 'di yang stong zhen yin snyam pa'i rtog pa 'ong*/ rgya la ba rgan dang ma bral na them pa la gtsang dus mi yong bas/ myong 'dod gcig ma dag gi bar la/ rtog pas thabs mi 'phag pa de ka phyag rgya chen po'i longs spyod yin pas/ sngar gyi gdam ngag gi gnad des lam du 'khyer ba yin/ de bzhin du rgod 'gyod bying rmugs la sogs pa bsam gtan gyi sgrib pa lnga yang*/ 'dis g.yang du 'gugs pa yin gsungs nas/ rgod 'gyod kyi 'bru gnod yang mdzad/ bsgom ngo mthong re snga mo nas byung yang skyed nus pa gcig yang mi yong pa thams cad dran pa kho rang*/ rang shugs la zad cing bsgom yad yud byung ba ma rtogs pa nyon mongs rnam rtog tu shar kyang*/ nyams len du 'dag mi nus/ rtog pa lam khyer gyi gnad 'di med/ chos sku yin ye shes yin snyam pa'i go yul res phyi brdeg tu dus re la rgyas btab cing 'jog par 'dug ste las yogs che bas phan med/ bsgom chen pa phal cig rnam rtog rgya 'byams kyi gseb na bsgom mun nag gi glog lta bu yad yud kyam kyem yong ba ma rtogs pa/ thams cad go yul du shor nas/ go cha drag pa kun kyang bzlas pa re la kha ldan gyis 'gro ba yin par gda'/ rje 'bri khung bas zab la rgya che ba'i chos gsungs pa'i rjes la/ phyag g.yas pa'i rtse mo g.yon pa'i mthil du gtsugs nas/ bu kun hril gyis dril na 'di las med/ dran pa mkhas na bsgom mkhas gsung*/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ dran pas ma zin go yul yin// sangs rgyas lam du 'gro mi srid// ces gsung*/ 'gro mgon klu grub kyis kyang*/

dbang phyug lung rtogs dran pa bde gshegs kyis// bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam 'di nye bar bstan// de la bsgrims nas mngon par bsrung bgyis te// dran pa nyams pas chos kun 'jig par 'gyur// ces gsungs pas dran pas zin pa las sa chod che ba med/ blo bskyed med tshad bsgom skyong ma shes pas lan pa yin/ skyong ba las dran pas zin pa las zab pa med de/ de la gnad 'di med na/ bsgom dma' dus su dran pa rang gi 'ching bar 'dug rnam rtog lam khyer gyi skad 'di bu chung lo gsum pa'i kha na yang yod de/ nyams su len bsgom chen pa rgad pos kyang mi shes/ bzang po 'dod pa kun gyis kyang nyams len gyi gnad 'di mi shes par ma bcos par glod la zhog bya ba de gang bya ba na 'dug ste zer nas/ nyams su blang rin mi chog pa'i chos su byas nas/ kha thon byed gsung*/ gnyis pa nyon mongs pa lam du 'khyer ba dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba yang sngar bzhin rtog pa gang shar gyi thog tu ma yengs par gsal ye re bzhag pas 'gyur ba yin/ de yang rtag gnyis las/ ji ltar rlung gis zin pa la// mon sran gre'u'i bza' ba sbyin// bzlog pa'i sman ni btang ba las// rlung gis rlung la bsnun par byed// rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog 'dag /sred pa nyid kyis sred pa 'dag /ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa// chu gzhan gyis ni 'gugs par bya// de bzhin dngos po'i rnam rtog kyang*// rnam par nges par sbyang par bya// ji ltar me yis tshig pa la// me de nyid la gdug par bya// de bzhin 'dod chags mes tshig pa// 'dod chags me yis dbyung bar bya// skye bo mi bzad pa yi las/ gang dang gang gis 'chi gyur ba// thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyi// srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur// ces gsung*/ dpal sam bu sam+bu ṭa las kyang*/ chags pas chags pa 'dag 'gyur te// zhe sdang nyid kyi zhe sdang sbyang*// gti mug nyid kyis gti mug sbyang*// nga rgyal nyid kyis nga rgyal sbyang*// phrag dog nyid kyi phrag dog sbyang*// rdo rje 'dzin sogs thams cad sbyong*// ces gsungs pas/

sems 'di 'dod chags su skyes pa'i dus su/ tha mal pa ltar rjes su yang mi 'breng*/ thun mong gi theg pa ltar spong yang mi spong*/ chos sku yin ye shes yin snyam pa'i nges shes kyang mi byed par/ rang thog du glod nas 'dzin med du bcas bcos med par 'jog pa yin/ 'dod chags su lam me ba re rang la nyams len gyi ngo ti byas nas/ de las gzhan pa'i rtog pas gsal ye re bsgom pa yin/ der 'dod chags kyi 'dzin pa de ma spangs gnas su dag nas/ bde stong so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su krongs te 'char te/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi thugs dgongs pa mngon du byas pa yin no// skyes bu 'dod chags can rnams kyang*/ 'dod chags nyid kyis thul bar 'gyur bya ba yang*/ 'dod chags med pa'am chung du 'gro ba ma yin/ ra li las/ 'dod chags la rten bde ba yul drug gi /dgra rnams bcom nas gnyis med ye shes thob// ces so// 'dod chags la brten nas dag grol thob pa la zer ba yin/ 'dod chags che ba'i gang zag de la/ 'dod chags de nyid lam du byas na/ gzhan gang las kyang lam chod che gsung*/ de la nga'i gdam ngag gi gnad 'di yod na/ su 'dod chags che ba 'tshengs pa yin te/ dper na rta mgyogs pa skyes bus chun na rtsol med du lam chod pa ltar nyon mongs pa drag po gdams pa'i gnad kyis zin na/ nyon mongs pa de nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi sar skyel ba yin/ de la slob dpon tsan dra go mis/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ ched 'gar nyon mongs pa spong ba bzhin byed la/ ched 'gar bskyed pa bzhin byed do gsung*/ ched du 'dod chags skye ba'i yul du byas shing skyes pa dang sngar bzhin phyag rgya chen po nyams su blangs pas/ 'dod chags chos skur shes te/ chags pa rtsad nas chod nas der 'dod chags gcig pu la nyon mongs pa lnga kha tshang bas/ der 'dod chags gcig pa'i steng du/ nyon mongs thams cad kyi thog thag chod nas/

yid la med par grub thob tu 'gro/ 'dod chags phyag rgya chen po'i dbang du 'dus tsa na/ 'dod chags las grub pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad dbang du 'du/ thabs lam gyi yon tan thams cad shugs la yong gsung/ nyams len gyi gnad 'di yod na las rgya mi dgos gsung*/ gnyis med kyi rtogs pas ma zin na/ rlung nus kyis thig le ma shor kyang lam du mi 'gro'am snyam/ rgyud sam+bu ṭa las kyang*/ rdo rje 'dzin sogs thams cad sbyong*// ces pa yang*/ zhe sdang thabs kyis zin nas chos skur shar na rdo rje 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du 'dod chags chos skur shar nas pad ma 'dzin pa/ nga rgyal rin chen/ phrag dog chos skur shar nas rgya gram 'dzin pa/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i nang gi thugs dgongs mtshon pa yin/ nyon mongs pa chos skur shar na rgyal ba rigs lnga dang*/ thugs dgongs gcig tu gyur pa yin/ nyon mongs lam du byed pa'i go ba rang nyon mongs pa'i nus pas chos sku'i rtsal sbyong zhing dprag 'don/ gnyis med kyi rtogs pas nyon mongs pa'i dag byed byas nas/ dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba yin nam snyam/ spros bral dus su rtog pa phra mo rnams dran pa ma yengs par rang gi chos skur 'char ste/ chags sdang drag po rnams la nyon mongs lam 'khyer gyi gnad 'di med na/ phyag rgya chen po mi 'char gsung*/ de ltar 'dod chags lam du 'khyer bas bar do'i mngal sgo 'gogs pa la tshegs mi 'ong ste/ pha ma 'khrig sred byed pa mthong tsa na/ chos sku'i ngo sprod du 'char/ de ma shar yang sngar goms pa'i stobs kyis yul thog der glod cing 'dzin med du der 'jog pa de shugs la yong der skad cig gnyis pa la yul ma spangs gnas su dag nas chos skur 'char gsung*/ 'dod chags la rgyas su sbyar nas/ de bzhin du zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog la sogs pa la yang bsres nas gsung*/ zhe sdang gi skabs su mngon shes kyi bsgrub pa 'di las zab pa med gsung*/

gsum pa lha 'dre lam du 'khyer ba bar chod dngos grub tu bsdud pa la yang 'di las zab pa med/ lho brag mkhar chu lta bu gnas gnyan po gcig du sdod pa'i dus su nyi ma rgas nas mar 'jigs 'jigs yong*/ de'i dus su 'jigs rtog de ngos rtsir gyis bzung nas sems bcas bcos med par gang shar de'i thog tu lhan te bzhag nas/ 'jigs snang de rang la bsgom gyi ngo ti byas te/ shes pa dru pa ston pa de la gsal ye re bsgoms pas/ 'jigs snang de nyid nyams su bkrongs te yong*/ de ka'i rjes la 'jigs snang med par bag gro chil te 'gro/ yang de nyid la chags zhen med par nyams su blangs pas rjes la 'jigs snang byung yang 'gag blo mi skye ba yin bde ba la bsgrub blo byung na/ sdug bsngal la 'gag blo skye ba chos nyid yin gsung*/ gsang spyod lam chod che ba'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ gnas gnyan po rnams su phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten 'brel 'grig pas/ phyi rol du gdon gyi cho 'phrul rgyud la rigs 'dra'i nyon mongs pa/ lus thog tu na tsha cis kyang 'byung bas yang na bar chod du 'gro/ yang na bogs thon pa las btang snyoms su mi lus nges pa yin/ de yang klu gdon drag po gnas pa'i sa der/ klu'i cho 'phrul ci yang yong*/ de yang klu dang sa bdag rnams rang gi gti mug gi gzugs brnyan phyir shar ba yin pas nang du gnyid mig dang nge ba la 'gro ba yong*/ sngon nga la dus tshod gcig la/ 'gro yin 'gro yin pa la gnyid du 'gro ba byung*/ sa gzhi bar snang thams cad sbrul gyis gang ba'i snang ba byung tsa na/ shig nad brgyab nas de shi de chad byung*/ shig nad 'di yang sa gdon du 'dug gsung*/ de'i dus su lus kyi phyed sha ror song*// phyis te tse log nas sangs rgyas yon gyis brtag pa mkhyen pas mig la gzigs pas bu klu yis de'u khyer 'dug gsung*/ de nas lha khab du lo khyur po gsum ma drag

/de nas rtsa ri gnas byin brlabs can du drag pa yin/ de lus thog du mdze nad la sogs pa yong ba yin/ 'di'i dus su gdon drag po'i cho 'phrul gang byung kyang sngar gyi gdam ngag gis nyams su blang*/ bzlog bsgom dang spros bcas la sogs pa 'di rnams kyang rang thog tu ro ma snyoms pa'i tsab tsub yin pas/ ro snyoms kyi dgongs pa cung len/ cho 'phrul dang gdug rtsub che zhing 'tshengs pa yin/ de ka 'dod pas bsnyags pa yin pas sngar bzhin bsgom/ mdor na 'jigs nas phyir 'don mi nus pa snyams byed pa de la/ gnyen po spros bcas dang bzlog bsgom la sogs pa bya'am snyam pa'am rtog pa 'bur byung tshad kyi steng du sngar bzhin phyag rgya chen po brkyangs pas/ rtog pa de chos skur 'char ba dang*/ gdon dbang du 'dus pa srang kha mthon dman bzhin 'ong*/ phyi'i rten 'brel der klu de chos skyong du byung tsa na nang du gti mug 'od gsal du 'char lus thog gi nad drag pa dang gsum grub bde gcig tu yong*/ dgon pa la sogs par lo gsum bzhi dam bcas nas bsgoms pa bas gnyan sar zhag gsum gsang spyod byas pa bgos che bar gsungs pa yin/ chos rje ras pa'i man ngag 'di/ nang gi las dang nyon mongs pa bag la nyal ba thams cad phyi dbang po'i mngon sum du/ thang bde ba la/ ston du yong pa'i gdam ngag yin/ sangs mi rgya ba'i thabs med gsung*/ nang du nyon mongs pa'i rigs gang mthong ba de ngos bzung nas/ de'i rigs 'dra'i gdon gar yod sar gsang spyod byed pa yin/ lha 'dre drag po dang thugs pa byung na yang*/ de gnas sar phyin nas kho'i rigs 'dra'i nyon mongs pa de/ phyag rgya chen pos nyams su blangs pas/ gdon de thul nas chos skyong du yong*/ nang du nyon mongs pa'i mda' dug khog tu zhen pa de/ phyi rol du lha 'dre'i gzugs su dngos su ston pa de nyid phyag rgya chen po'i rang bkor du 'khyer ba'i gdam ngag 'di 'dra la khyed kyis bsgrub pa gcig ma byung na re 'phangs gsung*/

don bzhi pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal lam du khyer ba byang chub sems kyi gdam ngag bya ba yin te/ de yang yul sems can sdug bsngal ba mthong tsam na/ a tsa ma 'di 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal lus thog tu byung na bzod re shi snyams nas yul de snying mi rje bar rang der skyes kyis dgos nas dge sbyor la blo hril hril 'gro ba byung na/ nyan rang gi blo sna yin pas/ de ngos bzung la/ rtog pa de'i steng du sems bcas bcos med par bzhag la mnyam du ro snyoms pa dang*/ yul des gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad la byams snying rje bsgoms pas/ ro myong pa dang dge sbyor yan lag bdun pa ltar smon lam gdab/ yul sdug pa mthong pa dang*/ snying rje tshad med par rang gzhan rje nus pa 'dug na byang chub sems dpa'i thugs dgongs yin pas/ rtog pa de ngos bzung la sngar bzhin ro snyoms te/ phyag rgya chen po la ma yengs pa la gdangs snying rjer lam me ba'i stong nyid dang snying rje zung 'jug gi ngang nas smon lam gdab/ gzhan yang khams gsum gyi sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal la bsam cing*/ de la snying rje skyes pa dang sngar bzhin ro snyoms cing smon lam gdab/ de ltar phyag rgya chen pos rtsir te zin nas/ byams pa bsgom tshad gnyug ma byams chen/ snying rje bsgom tshad dmigs med snying rje/ smon 'jug gnyis kyi sems bskyed byas tshad don dam sems bskyed/ dge ba byas tshad zag pa med pa'i dge bar 'gyur pa lags mod/ mdor na mar kyang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sa mtshams 'khor gsum du rtog mi rtog la bzung nas yod/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas kyang*/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bur// mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na// byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan gzung*// ces bshad gsung*/ phyag rgya chen pos ma zin tshad 'jig rten pa'i lam yin pas/

smon lam dang byams sems la sogs pa gang bsgoms kyang*/ rgyud pa'i rgyu'am/ gnas skabs gtsang ma'i gnas la sogs pa min pa rang gzhan gnyis ka grol mi nus te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bdag dang sems can snying rje gsum du dmigs pa de ni snying rje chung ngu yin la/ bdag ma mthong sems can ma mthong bar thams cad mnyam pa nyid du shes pa ni snying rje chen po yin no ces bshad gsung*/ don lnga pa na tsha lam du 'khyer ba 'byung ba ro snyoms kyi gdams ngag la/ rlung 'khris bad kan sa gdon dang gcong nad rnying pa'am/ mdor na nad kyi rigs ci byung yang nyams len gcig las med gsung*/ dang po rnam rtog ngos gzung*/ bar du bdag 'dzin blos gtang*/ tha ma re dogs kyi 'phrang bsal ba gsum yin/ nad ngos 'dzin pa la ro snyoms nas du ma gcig gsungs kyang*/ dbang po mchog dman thams cad la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin/ nged rang gi lugs kyis nad khyod rang ci yis bskyed mod/ rkyen gang gis bslang mod/ 'bras bu nad rigs gang yin mod/ lus thog na nad zug gam mi bde ba gang 'dug pa de/ dgag bsgrub chags sdang gi ngor ma shor bar/ nyams len ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo ti ra ngos 'dzin pa de la/ dang po rnam rtog ngos bzung zer ba yin/ dpal bhir wa pa'i lam 'bras nas/ nyams sems la 'char ba/ sngags ngag la 'char ba/ gar lus la 'char ba bya ba/ nang du zug la sems zin pas ngag tu hu khyu zer ba dang*/ lus 'gre ldog dang*/ ngo gnag pa la sogs pa 'ong bar gsungs 'dug /rje rin po che ko brag pa'i lam 'bras yang nga yi lag tu byung nas dar gyis gtub pa yod gsung*/ bar du bdag 'dzin blo yis btang ba bya ba 'di nyams len gyi ngo ti yin/ de yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa kun gsung pa bzhin/ sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'khor bar bskyur ba'i mkhan po bdag 'dzin 'dir 'dug /na ba 'di yang bdag 'dzin gyi lan 'dug pas/

da bdag 'dzin 'di blos thong dang zer yang*/ blos gtong mkhan rang bdag 'dzin yin pas/ spongs ba mi yong gsung nas bzhad cing 'dug 'o na ji ltar lags zhus pas/ bdag 'dzin dang nad zug tha dad med pas zug che bdo ba'i dus na/ sngar bzhin zug thog de rang du sems bcas bcos med par bzhag te/ zug de nyid nyams len ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo tir byas te na ba de rang la sems ma yengs par bsgoms pas/ zug gam bdag tu 'dzin pa de spang mi dgos par nyams len phyag rgya chen por krongs kyis yong*/ de zug sman du 'gyur bar ltar/ gzugs gam bdag 'dzin rang chos skur shar tsa na/ bdag 'dzin rtsal kyang mi rnyed pas/ bdag 'dzin blo yis gtong ba gsha' ma gcig de la yong bar 'dug gsung*/ tha ma re dogs kyi 'phrang bsal ba bya ba/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ nad drag tu re ba dang*/ ma drag gis dogs pa dang*/ sman nam bzlog bsgom gcig bya'am bsam pa la sogs pa thams cad/ ro ma snyoms pa'i nad thog der ma zug pa'i tsab tsub yin pas/ gang shar ba de ngos ma zin na des mi gtong pas/ sngar bzhin lta thog tu ro snyoms pa yin/ yang 'di 'dra ba'i snyoms 'jug pa nga 'dra ba gcig 'ong ba da rung rkyen mi nub par 'dug snyam pa'i rang la yi chad pa 'ong bas de la yang sngar bzhin ro snyoms pa yin/ yang pho gzer lta bu'i zug drag po tsha khangs pa la sems ma bcos par bzhag tsam na zug gi tshor ba mi 'gag kyang gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa gtan med par/ gnyis med gcig chod du lhangs kyis 'gro/ res tsa na zug dang tsha khangs khangs lus thog tu yong*/ rkyen la bsre 'dod kyi rtog pa mnyam par bzhags pas/ 'jog byed kyi rtog pa de nyid rang sar dag cing grol ba la sogs pa grol bya'i nges shes yan yun bag re rig thog tu yong ba lag pa'i rtse la yod pa yin/ de la nges shes phyin ma gcig gis gsos mi 'debs pa yin/ de byung dus su ro mi snyoms par/

gnyis 'dzin 'jug gin 'dug pa snyam pa'i blo mthud yong ste/ phyag rgya chen po la gnyis sam rtog med du bsgrub bsgrub po gcig bsgrub rgyu med pas so// gnyis snang dang rtog pa bkag tu med de/ rang gsal du ma bzhag par gsos btab pa'i skyon te/ cis na/ slob dpon hūm̐ ka ras/ kun yin gang yang ma yin pas// rig pa khyab bdal ngo bo yin// rang rig rang gnas bde chen po// ma lus kun gyi dngos gzhir gnas// ces gsungs pas/ blo 'dud dang 'gyod sel gang byung ba'i dus su sngar gyi ro snyoms kyis 'bur bcangs su nyams su len pa yin gsung*/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ yi thag chad pa men pa mi 'drag mi srid gsung*/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang gegs sel ba la rgyu bcos rkyen gsal ba/ 'bras bu gzhom pa gsum dgongs pa yin te/ nad thams cad kyi rang bzhin gzhi ma rig pas gzhir byas pa'i las dang nyon mongs yin/ de'i dag byed la phyag rgya chen po las lhag pa med de/ phyogs bcu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ gal te 'gyod tshangs byed 'dod na// drang por 'dug la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// 'di ni 'gyod tshangs mchog yin no// ces bshad gsung*/ rkyen bsal ba la nad thams cad kyi dang la rlung ldog des nad gzhi 'khrug nas 'byung ba yin la/ mgon po 'bri gung pa'i dmigs pa'i gnas skabs thams cad kyang rlung log thur du 'bebs par 'dug ste/ rlung log chen po rnams kyang phyag rgya chen po men pas mi 'drag par 'dug /thur du bsrings pa'i dmigs pa 'di rnams kyang*/ sems ma zin na phan med de/ sems zin na ni de rang gis rlung ldog rogs byed cing 'dug des na rnam par rtog pa phyag rgya chen po'i khog par bskyur tsa na/ rlung dang rnam rtog gnad gcig pas/ rlung ldog pa dang ldog mkhan gang yang mi yong gsung*/ 'bru gzhom pa la na ba nyid phyag rgya chen por shar tsam na/

nad zug sdug ge ro med khungs med du bcom nas/ dgag bsgrub kyi rtog pa'i rigs rtsa ba nas bcad pa yin de min na/ na ba des sngar gyi las ngan mdzad de snyam nas de la chags sdang skyes pas/ yang srid pa phyi ma'i rgyur song nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la mdzad pa med pa yin/ mthon dman bag chags sna tshogs kun// sgom ro gcig dus na slongs pa yin// slongs nas 'dag par ma shes na// phyir ma bcings nas 'dag pa dka'// ces rje 'bri gung pas gsung*/ ngas mi tshe na ba la bskyal te/ dgag bsgrub kyi chags sdang ma byas/ na ba'i thog nas thar pa'i lam bgrod/ sgrib pa'i thog nas bcad pa yin/ khong rnams kyis dbang med rim 'gro byas tsa na/ ngas bla ma dkon mchog thugs mi chad par zhu'o// nga la ni rim 'gro 'di la ltos pa spu tsam yang med byas gsung*/ nad drag nas de la rlom sems 'jug gin 'dug na/ de sman ma zhu ba dug du song ba dang 'dra bas/ ro snyom pa gal che/ na ba'i dus rang du yang*/ na tsha lam khyer gyi gnad kyis khor gcig zug chag na/ da rang na ba drag par 'dug /zug langs kyang bsgoms pas chog snyam/ de nas bag tsam na ru byung tsam na/ da rung na ru 'ong par 'dug bsgom dgos snyams nas ro snyoms la ldog sngags rnon po bzhin/ nad de'i gnyen por shor dogs yod pas/ rtog pa de mi bgegs byung dus su ro snyoms pa gal che/ 'di 'byung ring po men gsung*/ phyir ro snyoms kyi gnad che shos gong du 'dun pa gtong ba 'di yin/ rkyen drag po gcig dang thug na dga' ste/ de'i dus su nga lta thog tu ro snyoms ste/ snyam pa byas pas/ rkyen dang 'phrad pa dang*/ gcig chod du hril gyis 'gro/ dper na jag pa nyung dus tshong pa mang po 'joms pa dang 'dra/ de gnyis dang gcig yong la re/ gcig byung gis dogs pas/ mdun pa'i khyad zhugs pa yin/ don drug pa 'chi ba lam 'khyer ma bu lam du 'khyer ba ro snyoms thams cad la 'gro ba yin don la ma shi bar du rgyun du bsgoms pas 'chi khar sngar goms shugs kyis phyag rgya chen po la shugs kyis 'gro/

der 'od gsal ma bu gcig tu 'dres nas rtogs pa'i rang gzugs su chos kyi sku ru sangs rgya ba yin/ chos sku'i nus pa'am rtsal du bar do'i dod por longs sku mtshan dpes brgyan par sems dpa' rnams la snang nas/ dag pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams kyi don byed/ skye ba len pa'i dod por sprul pa'i sku rnams kyis nyan rang dang byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams la gang la gang 'dul gyi skur bstan nas 'dul ba yin/ de yang rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ces pa'am/ chos nyid 'dus ma byas pas gzhan du mtshan nyid med pa'i bar do dang po gang shed nas yong pa gcig kho na min/ chos nyid ma zhes kyang bya/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'di rtogs pa las 'byung bas/ yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma zhes kyang bya/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa sems can thams cad la rang bzhin gyis yod pa de tshogs drug gi snang bar gsal bas/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal zhes kyang bya/ ming ci ltar btags kyang tshogs drug gi snang ba ma bcos pa 'di la zer ba yin/ slob dpon hūm̐ ka ras kyang*/ gar yang ma 'gags cir yang shar// rang byung ye shes ngo bor 'dus// mtha' rnams gar yang ma spangs bral// lhun grub bde chen rang bzhin pa'i// sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos gzhir rtogs// ces gsungs pa yin/ rtogs pa'i 'od gsal lam/ rig pa ye shes su zhes bya ba yang*/ bla ma'i byin brlabs kyis gshis kyis gnas lugs rtogs pa 'di ka yin/ rtog pa de rtog pa lam khyer gyi gnad kyis bogs 'don cing nyams su blang pa gcig la/ 'od gsal bar do dang po shes pa'i smin dus nges pa can min pas/ 'chi kha ma'i gdam ngag gis kha bsgyur tsa na/ chos sku thog pa yin/ da lta ci yang skye rgyu med par 'chi tsa na/ dkar lam byung ngo*// dmar lam byung ngo*// da lta 'od gsal 'ong ngo snyam du ra bgrangs ba bzhin du byas kyang 'od gsal mi zin/ de rnam rtog yin/

rnam rtog ma rig pa yin/ ma rig pa dang 'od gsal dngos 'gal yin gsung*/ 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i gnad la/ da lta rtog pa lam khyer gyi gdams ngag gis/ snang ba 'di ma bcos par skyong ba las zab pa med pas ro snyoms skor drug bya ba g.yer che ba yin mod/ ro snyoms kyi gnad 'di sngon du slob dpon hūm̐ ka ras kyang gsungs 'dug /ji skad du/ de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// sems 'di ma bcos so mar zhog /dbang po ma dgag so mar zhog /gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs// gang mthong gang snang de nyid kyi// ngang la mnyam par lhang nge bzhag /gang yang mi 'gogs mi 'dzin cing*// mnyam nyid rig pa'i gdeng la zhog /de ltar rtogs cing goms pa yis// me yi phung po 'bar ba la// yam shing mnyam po bsnan pa bzhin// dngos po gang mthong gang snang kyang*// de nyid ye shes rgyun du 'char// nur bur mi bsgom gang bder bzhag /de ltar sems la dbang thob nas// phyogs cig kho nar mi bsgom te// ting 'dzin 'bum phrag du ma yang*// rnal 'byor rig pa'i rtsal chen sbyang*// rig pa mtha' dbus med pa yi// gdeng chen spyi blugs nyid du 'char// nam mkha'i mthongs su mdung bskor bzhin// rig pa rang la rang dbang bsgyur// de ltar gdeng tshud bsgom pa'i mchog /de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// spyod pa blang dor med par spyad// spang ni ci yang mi spang la// ched du gang yang bya rgyu med// spyod pa ma 'gags blang dor bral// ma bsgrubs 'bras bu bdag nyid rdzogs// ma blangs dngos grub rang la shar// ma bsgrod sa lam lhun gyis rdzogs// ces gsungs te/ deng sang phyag len du slong shes pa ces rje ras pa tsam yin gsung*/ des na spyir rtog pa thams cad khyad par du 'chi sems kyi rnam rtog snying khong drang ldong pa 'di yang lus sems la bden 'dzin ltas pa'i rtags yin pas/ sngar bzhin nyams su blangs pas 'chi sems kyi rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag nas/

bar do gsum gyi rtog snang yal/ 'di dang phyi ma gcig tu 'dres bya ba yong ba yin/ 'di phyi bar do skad cig snga phyi nyin mo mtshan mo phyed gong dang phyed gong la sogs pa 'di rnams sems gnyug ma ma bcos pa'i gsal snang la rtog pas brda' btags ri mo bris pa yin gsung*/ de ltar tshe 'di la nyams len thul tshud par byas nas/ 'chi dus na bla ma bzhugs na bsags pa rab yin/ mi bzhugs kyang chos grogs rnal mo gan du bzhag la/ bdag tu bzung ba spu tsam med pa byas nas/ rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos yin pas gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu bcug pa'am/ rtsol ba nus na me rlung gyen du 'bar ba chos nyid yin pas/ tsog pur song yang 'khrul 'khor gyi 'pho bar 'gro ba yin gsung*/ gang ltar yin kyang spyi bor bla ma bsgoms la/ mos gus dungs pa gcig byas pa'i ngang nas/ sems bcas bcos med par lhod de shig ge bzhag de'i dus su yul rkyen ngan pa la gzabs pas/ dus tshod chen por song ba dang nyams len la cag khrims 'gro ba las yengs dogs med/ de gcig gcig po byung 'dug 'khor 'das kyi 'gyes 'tshams yin yengs thabs med do snyam ste/ khrim gyis bsgrims pas dran pa de rang rgyud par shor na/ lam gyi gegs byas dogs yod pas/ shes pa 'khyer thabs cag khrims byung ba'i dus su/ de rang rtog pa lam khyer gyi gnad kyis sngar bzhin nyams su blangs pas/ zung 'jug phyag rgya chen por lhod shig 'gro/ de'i ngang nas dbugs song na/ rig pa khyod rang 'phongs nas thon nas 'gro na rgyug /rab mngon par dga' ba'i sa zhes bya ba chos kyi skur sangs rgya gsung*/ de nga yi spar tshod min/ rgyud rnams su rdo rje 'chang zhes/ 'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog des// mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par byed// ces bshad// rje dam pa rgya gar gyis kyang*/ na ba na ba min/ 'byung ba dngas snyigs 'byed pa yin/ 'chi ba 'chi ba min/

rnal 'byor pa sangs rgyas pa yin/ bya ba gsungs 'dug pas/ dus gnad skems po re la song na/ sangs rgyas pa la ring po ka yang med gsung*/ de yang rtogs ldan gyi rnal 'byor 'chi kha ma de/ srid pa tha ma'i byang chub sems dpa' bya ba yin te/ srid pa tha ma pa rgyal bu don grub dka' thub las bzhengs nas/ rdo rje gdan du byang chub kyi shing drung du byon pa'i dus na/ gnas ngan len gyi dri ma phra ba gcig las spang rgyu med pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pa de yang 'chi bar shes pas/ rang gi nyams len gyi steng du sengs kyis song ba'i mi rtog par ngo shes/ rtog pa phra mo de las spang rgyu med/ gnas ngan gyi dri ma phra mo de/ bla ma'i mos gus dang*/ phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug gi rtog pa des spangs nas/ sangs rgyas ba yin/ zung 'jug gi rtog pa de la rdo rje lta bu'i sa ma ti zhes kyang bya ste/ mgon po byams pas/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin// rtog pas mi shigs thob nas ni// gnas gzhan 'gyur ba mthar thug pa// sgrib pa kun gyi dri ma med// ces bshad pas// 'khor 'das kyi bar na sbubs ha ba de las med/ 'bring dus kyi sa bar do// tha ma skye ba 'dzin pa'i sa bya ba gzugs sku gnyis thob tshul yin te/ shugs la yong gsung*/ hril dril na khyed rang*/ phar phyin pa gsung pa'i gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar thams cad/ chos rje ras pas rtog par bzhed pa yin/ rtog pa de'i rang bzhin gsal bzhag med par chos kyi skur ye nas zhugs med pa nges par 'khor bar 'khyam pa ste/ sangs rgyas gsang ba las/ grong khyer gsum gyi sems can rnams// bden pa mthong zhing des ma byas// ces gsungs nas/ grong khyer gsum song ba bsgrub pa zhig po'i zhal nas/ snang ba'i grong khyer 'dod khams/ mi snang ba'i grong khyer gzugs med/ phyed snang gi grong khyer gzugs khams yin gsung*/ lung khungs 'di rnams dang slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra'i gsung de rnams pha bsgrub pa zhig po'i gsung yin gsung*/

de ltar rtog pa chos skur ye nas bzhugs pa de// rang rig pa'i ye shes kyis mngon sum du zhal blta zhing nges par byed pa la na ra pa'i gnad ston rtog pa lam khyer zer ba yin no// ro snyoms kyi dgongs pa tig pa rang mthon dman gyi rtogs pa rgyud la tshar chos skur rol pa la ro snyoms zer/ rtog pa de nyid ma bcos par nyams len du 'khyer ba la rtog pa lam khyer zer ba yin/ de'i gdam ngag la gang shar gyi thog tu ma bcos par 'jog pas 'di las zab pa med/ 'di dang lung rigs kyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa gnyis rtog par gcig ste/ 'di la ma bcos par bzhag pa'i skad cig phyi logs su bzhag bya 'jog byed rtog pa de nyid rtog med rang gsal du krongs kyis 'char te/ 'di rang rig gi rtog pa yin/ gcig la yang thag chod kyi ngo shes gsha' ma de yong ste/ go yul las ma 'das/ shes rab can gyis las de nam mdo ha la sogs pa nyan tsa na/ bzhug tu bkyal 'og zhing 'dug pa las/ 'phral brgyud la skye ba ka 'dra ba yong gi 'dug gsung*/ chos rje rang gi rgyud 'dzin min pa la mi gtong pa lags so// bka' rgya'o// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo// rje nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ bla ma te phu ba la bod nas slob ma snod ldan gcig 'ong gis de la byin cig /da brgyud pa gsum na gdam ngag 'di'i bdag po gcig 'ong gis gsung*/ rje te phu pas ras chung pa la skal ldan du shes nas gdams/ rje ras chung pas bla ma'i gsung la brten nas lho brag mkhar chur gter du sbas nas/ skal ldan gcig dang 'phrad par shog ces smon lam btab bo// kha byang bla ma gsum la gtad/ des gling ras pa la gtad/ des kha byang gcig dang bcas pa gtsang pa rgya ras la lung bstan nas/ rin po ches lho brag mkhar chur bsgoms pas mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan nas/ gter bston pas ro snyoms bskor drug byung nas nyams su blangs pas skye rgyu bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung nas gzhan la yang dar bar mdzad do// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yis// rtag tu byin gyis brlab tu gsol// nā ro pa'i ro snyoms bskor drug 'di// bdud rtsi lta bu'i bcud dang ldan// mkha' 'gro ma yi srog snying yin// gzhan du ma spel sems la chongs// rje btsun te phu ba'i zhal nas kyang*/

dus bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// dus mgo 'jug log pa ra yi lo// gdams pa zab du mthong tsa na// phan par byas kyang gnod par go /dus ngan skye bo mgu ba dka'// gdams pa bstan na drin tshur 'dren// mon bod gnyis kyi sa 'tshams su// brag sog po khros pa 'dra ba yi// nang du sbos la zhog gcig gsung*// bka' rgyas btab nas gnang pa yi// gdams pa mkha' 'gro'i srog snying re shig spyir ro snyoms bskor drug yod kyang gsang spyod la 'dus so// de yang thog 'gel la 'dus so// nad thog tu nad 'bebs/ gdon thog tu gdon 'bebs/ thab thog tu gzhob gtong pa lags so// 'gro ba sems can ma lus pa// re dogs gcong nad rab zhi nas// sku sum sangs rgyas myur thob shog /nā ro pa/ te phu ba/ ras chung pa*/ gtsang pa/ rgod tshang pa/ u brgyan pa/ rje rang byung rdo rje'o/// /
